name: pdf-translate-extension-dev
description: 开发/测试脚手架：后台单元测试与隔离 Chromium 扩展回归，验证自带 pdf.js 阅读器的划词翻译链路。

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:unit: node --test test/unit.mjs test/layout.mjs test/backup-unit.mjs test/reader-unit.mjs test/chat.mjs test/desktop-unit.mjs
scripts.test:browser: node test/regression.mjs && node test/advanced.mjs && node test/usability.mjs && node test/reader-browser.mjs && node test/reader-backup-browser.mjs && node test/chat-browser.mjs && node test/chat-storage-browser.mjs && node test/document-storage-browser.mjs
